cmd.description: Open your global FFXIV ScionDex game menu.

tutorial:
On your Game Window there will be 3 items:

"⭐ **Stars**"
- accumulated from boss random drops or by releasing current party (minimum of total 10 stars to use release party).
- use to increase recruit chance.

"💎 **Shards**"
- accumulated from boss random drops or collected from defeated boss.
- use to summon 8-10★ NPC. Need 20 💎 per summon.

"🪶 **Phoenix Down**"
- accumulated from boss fights random drops. Cap at 10.
- use to revive party when wiped by the boss.
